verdict.rationale: Toolchain and version management is a fair question for a JavaScript package manager, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents nothing about Bun switching tool versions or loading environment variables automatically when you enter a project directory. Its docs cover installs, lockfiles, workspaces, the cache, and audits; the only environment-variable mention is a cache-path setting (`BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR`), which is not per-directory activation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the right tool versions and environment variables activate automatically when I enter a project directory
